description.en: The number of devices allowed for the pre-release.

description.zh:
是否为总量预发布。取值：**Y | N**。

> 总量预发布表示该预发布允许的设备数不会按照机型数平均分配，而是所有机型共享同一个允许设备数。
description.en:
Specifies whether this is a total pre-release. Valid values: **Y | N**.

> A total pre-release means that the allowed device count is not evenly distributed across device models. Instead, all device models share the same allowed device count.
The ID of the project to which the pre-release belongs.

description.en:
The version type. Valid values:

- **FOTA**: system version
- **APP**: application version.

descriptions.zh:
创建一个版本预发布，只允许在版本是“测试已通过”或“预发布”状态时才可创建。

- 系统版本只有一个机型，所以预发布只针对该机型。
- 应用版本可能有多个机型，预发布可根据**IsTotalPrepublish**参数决定，是对所有机型平均分配允许设备数，或是所有机型共享总允许设备数。
descriptions.en:
Creates a version pre-release. A pre-release can be created only when the version is in the "Test Passed" or "Pre-release" state.

- A system version has only one device model, so the pre-release targets only that device model.
- An application version may have multiple device models. You can use the **IsTotalPrepublish** parameter to determine whether to evenly distribute the allowed device count across all device models or to share the total allowed device count across all device models.
